definitions.explanation: A written or spoken representation of something; the act of describing or writing about something.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しい{記述|きじゅつ}を{求|もと}める。
{歴史的|れきしてき}な{記述|きじゅつ}によると。
{記述|きじゅつ}{式|しき}の{問題|もんだい}に{答|こた}える。

notes:
{記述|きじゅつ} refers to the act of writing something down in a descriptive or explanatory way, or the resulting written description. It has a formal, academic tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記述|きじゅつ}する: to describe, to write down
- {記述|きじゅつ}{式|しき}: essay-type, descriptive (as in exam questions requiring written answers, as opposed to {選択|せんたく}{式|しき} multiple choice)
- {詳細|しょうさい}な{記述|きじゅつ}: detailed description
- {歴史的|れきしてき}な{記述|きじゅつ}: historical account
- {正確|せいかく}な{記述|きじゅつ}: accurate description

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {記載|きさい}: writing/listing (more formal, used for official records and documents)
- {描写|びょうしゃ}: depiction (visual or literary, emphasizes vividness)
- {叙述|じょじゅつ}: narration (telling a story or sequence of events)
- {説明|せつめい}: explanation (focuses on making something understood)

{記述|きじゅつ} emphasizes the written record or account itself, while {説明|せつめい} focuses more on helping the listener/reader understand.
